ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 75:25 ratio of high-intensity light-grey/white pixels (lobes) to low-intensity black pixels (central peduncle transition, borders, and scars).
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Two large, roughly triangular light-grey contiguous regions covering the majority of the left and right lobes, bisected by a vertical black pixel column at the center; black pigmentation forms a continuous 5-15 pixel wide border along the trailing edge and lateral tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with a calculated angle of approximately 65 degrees and a bounding-box depth extending significantly into the central black pigmentation.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude irregular peaks and valleys along the entire trailing edge; notable macro-indentations and irregular 'chewed' pixel boundaries are present on the distal third of the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Distinctly concave curve following the trailing edge from the median notch to the lateral tips on both lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of high-contrast, heterogeneous pixel texture (white and dark brown/black) localized at the extreme distal tips of both lobes, consistent with barnacle colonization.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: One prominent, long diagonal dark linear mark on the left lobe; several shorter, horizontal and vertical linear pixel disruptions (scratches) scattered across both light-grey lobe surfaces.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive epibiotic (barnacle) clusters at both lateral lobe tips and multiple healed linear rake marks distributed across the ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: A distinct 'tadpole-shaped' dark pigmentation mark consisting of a circular focal point with a trailing line, located in the lower-medial quadrant of the right lobe.
